featured_reviews.name: dharmesh chasia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have serviced my bike 3 times, and honestly, this has been the worst service experience of my life.

The first thing that happens is Mr. Sachin main mechanic, checks your bike and says parts need to be replaced. First he asks whether you will arrange the parts, then slowly says he will “manage” them himself. He gains your confidence very smartly.

What I also noticed is that he gives certain signs or gestures to the workshop team while talking to customers. Regular customers will understand this. It genuinely feels like there is an internal understanding about whom to charge extra, whom to avoid, or how to handle different customers.

He talks very politely:
“Gaon gaye the kya sir?”
“Bohot time baad aaye…” acha maitain kiya bike yaar and similar sweet conversations — but honestly, after my experience, it all feels fake and part of gaining customer trust.

Once you hand over your bike and keys, your bike is freely used by the mechanics for personal rides. I have personally noticed my bike being taken out multiple times for tea breaks, lunch breaks, and random spins before coming back to the workshop.

One shocking thing water outlet pipe on my bike was replaced with a simple green rubber faucet pipe — literally a household-type pipe installed as a “jugaad” solution.

The owner also has a standard dialogue during billing: price bad gaya hai ha sir
“Part bohot mushkil se mila… iska price badh gaya hai… ladka dur gaya tha
But in reality, most parts are simply sourced from nearby local shops around the Andheri Chakala area. Near Cigarette factory

if you give your bike with enough fuel, Mr. Sachin will say:
“Petrol khatam ho gaya tha, maine ₹100 ka dala.”  and he will take 100 for that but it's fake

They also show you a full 1-liter engine oil bottle, but only around 650–750 ml is actually used in the bike. The remaining oil is never returned to the customer. Bottle fek diya yaar

Even small things like cloth, basic consumables are charged at inflated prices

The actual servicing is mostly done by untrained or inexperienced workers, while Mr. Sachin only comes at the end to explain things as if he personally handled everything.

Most importantly, the original problem for which you give your bike is usually NEVER solved properly. Every time the answer is:
“Kal aana… Sunday aana… thoda time lagega… free hoke check karta hoon.”
And when you actually visit again, you end up standing there for hours without any proper attention.

I went on a ride to Alibaug and my bike broke down there. The local mechanic checked the bike and immediately told me:
“Sir, oil toh patla ho gaya hai… properly dala hi nahi hai.”
That moment confirmed all my doubts about this workshop. sachin and owner are not true

I used to service my 160cc bike here 2–3 years ago, and even back then the bills were higher than what many better service centers charge today.

Overall, this place survives on excuses, temporary fixes, overbilling, fake politeness, and false promises. Posting this review only to save other bike owners from wasting their time, money, fuel, and trust.

5 stars to these professionals.
My Honda City quarter panel was badly damaged by a dumper. I reached Kalpana Auto Service after reading their reviews and trust me, they are the best in the business. They did proper inspection of my vehicle and fixed it like nothing happened to the car and made it like new.
They will give you periodic updates of your car, share photos and videos to keep you updated on the progress.
Vishal Shinde was assigned to my car and  he is a gem of a person, a true professional who explains you everything in detail.
They take your consent before making any changes in the car.
Their paint job was exceptionally good.
First time I had such an amazing experience with a car garage.
Vishal Shinde and team did an amazing job on the car and I am truly satisfied.
They also complimentary painted and changed many minor parts in the cars since they themselves were not satisfied with them as it was spoiling the look of the car.
If you want to get any car work done, this is the right place to be without giving any second thought.
Thank you Vishal and team, 5 stars to your service.

I was then quoted the price which was much lower than what the official service centre was expecting. All parts they used were genuine.

The work was done and all the important messages conveyed promptly. I also had major dents on my doors and front bumper. I was asked if I wanted to get it done. I said yes and within a couple of days the vehicle was delivered scratch less within a couple of days. Attaching some of the photos they sent below. The price for the denting work was also lower than what you would expect.

Overall, the work done here is very professional, timely, diligent and thorough. I would highly recommend them even for complicated cars like mine as they had no issues figuring out and solving the problem.

Overall great job guys!
